notes.title: Bugfix
notes.content:
I watched an Origami Flight gameplay video and noticed some bugs. Since a lot of people decide to give Origami Flight a chance during the holidays, I removed the rust from the code and tried to fix the following bugs (which I believed was sucessful):

[list]
[*] Localization bug on non supported languages.
[*] Final Boss sound effects on loop.
[/list]

Wish you all happy holidays and that 2021 be a better year.
If everything goes fine, I might fix some other bugs in the near future.
Don't forget to report any you find!
Thanks!

notes.title: Origami Flight on Linux + SteamOS
notes.content:
Linux version of Origami Flight has just been released! That means that we are good to go on SteamOS as well! Have fun everyone! Mac users, you're next!

We also corrected a bug that some of you have reported to us:
> Fixed repeated selection sound effect on Origami Book menu.

If you come across any bug, send us a message! We will happily check it out and fix it as soon as possible!

Thanks a lot!

notes.title: Origami Flight: finally released!
notes.content:
Hello everyone.

It's been a long time since this game was greenlit. And also for a long time I've been developing this game on my own. Lots of people have worked and contributed for this game until I was the only one left. And that's me, the one who write to you. 

So, since I'm a single non-professional developer, updates and fixes will probably come sparsely. For example, Linux version of the game will be up in about 2 weeks. I'm expecting bugs to show up, but I do hope you have some fun anyway! Feel free to comment and tell your experience in the game's community.

Thanks a lot!

notes.title: New release date: April 1st
notes.content:
Hi everybody!

Due to technical issues, we'll have to postpone Origami Flight's release in two weeks. It's sad, but it's for the best! 

We know, we know, new release data is on April's fool, but we won't trick you! We promise...! ːsteammockingː

notes.title: We have a release date!
notes.content:
Hi everybody!

We finally have a release date! Hope you stay tuned for more info about the game! I promise I'll keep you updated!

Cheers,
Sid
